description: A small sealed stone chamber with crystal accents set into floor and ceiling around a low plinth -- a quiet landmark room, no combat/mechanic attached. 14x11px.
notes: Modeled on the pyramid/ruin saves' PQRT-as-treasure-accent convention (2298674) scaled down to a real QRTZ crystal motif consistent with world.lua's existing geode/crystal-cave mechanic, so a shrine reads as 'more of that, concentrated' rather than a new material vocabulary.
